chunks: Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman narrated from Muhammad ibn Humran, from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
"Women do not inherit from the land or from the real estate anything."
ai.seo_question: Do women inherit from land and real estate in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* through the chain of Zurara and Muhammad ibn Muslim, this hadith from Imam al-Baqir clarifies that the prohibition of women inheriting land applies specifically to agricultural land (al-ard) and real estate (al-'iqar), distinguishing it from general movable assets. This ruling highlights the nuanced Shia jurisprudential approach to property classification, where the nature of the asset dictates inheritance rights, reflecting the economic context of early Islamic society.
